import asyncio, asyncpg

async def listen():
    conn = await asyncpg.connect(dsn=os.environ['DATABASE_URL'])
    async def cb(connection, pid, channel, payload):
        print(f'received on {channel}: {payload}')
    await conn.add_listener('{{channel}}', cb)
    print('listening...')
    while True:
        await asyncio.sleep(60)

asyncio.run(listen())
